title: Left Edge Sneaker Stays Visible
tests: Tests subject-aware reframing of an off-centre product instead of a default centre crop that loses the subject.

faults.what: The crop cuts off the sneaker's heel and rear portion at the left edge, directly violating the instruction to keep the whole shoe.

judge.summary: The output is square but crops away the sneaker's heel and rear section instead of preserving the complete shoe.

must_haves.why: The output has equal width and height.

must_haves.item: The output includes the original left-side sneaker, not an empty crop of the middle of the source.
must_haves.why: The original sneaker is present, although only part of it remains visible.

must_haves.item: The complete sneaker remains visible, including toe, heel and sole.
must_haves.why: The heel, rear upper and rear sole are cut off by the left edge.

must_haves.item: The sneaker's proportions, colour and details match the source.
must_haves.why: The visible portion retains the source's proportions, white colour, stitching and sole details, though it is enlarged.

must_haves.item: Any added padding blends with the source background, with no text or decorative additions.
must_haves.why: The plain light-grey padding matches the source's light-grey background area, and no text or decorations were added.
